title: Campus Canteen Lunch
description: Student scans the official QR sticker at the campus canteen counter to pay for a lunch combo.

title: College Library Printing Fee
description: Student pays for project-report printing at the college library using its official UPI QR.

title: Friend Dinner Split via WhatsApp
description: Classmate Arjun shares a UPI QR on WhatsApp to settle a restaurant bill split.

title: Hostel Office Maintenance Fee
description: Student pays the official hostel-office UPI QR for a registered maintenance service request.

title: WhatsApp Cashback-Reward Scam
description: A QR forwarded in a hostel WhatsApp group claims the scanner will receive instant cashback. The QR actually debits the user's account.

title: Exam-Fee Phishing Link
description: A QR forwarded in a student class group links to an external portal instead of a UPI address, aiming to steal credentials or money.

title: Tampered Canteen Sticker — Look-alike with High Amount
description: A fraudulent sticker with 'canteenn@testbank' (one extra letter) is placed over the real canteen QR; the amount is inflated well above normal lunch prices.

title: Suspicious Vendor Invoice with Urgency
description: An employee receives a payment request from an unrecognized UPI handle; the note uses urgency language to pressure an immediate transfer.
